title: iv_set is set ONLY after successful copy_to_user in gen_iv
description: In ioctl_gen_iv, the iv_set flag is set to true ONLY after copy_to_user succeeds (crypto2dev_fd.c line 985-987 pattern: generate IV → attempt copy_to_user → set iv_set only on success). If copy_to_user fails after the IV is generated, iv_set remains false, preventing the caller from proceeding to write() with an IV they never received. A reviewer might refactor to set iv_set before copy_to_user for simplicity. That would allow a caller whose buffer write failed to proceed to encrypt with an IV they do not possess — producing ciphertext undecryptable by the intended receiver and undetectable by the module.
